## Change

Describe the user-visible problem and resulting behavior.

## Verification

List the checks performed and any remaining limitations.

## Release impact

For a substantive product change, propose a concise What’s new bullet and a patch/minor/major version impact. For docs-only or internal changes, say “none”. These are proposals until reconciled with the commits included in a release; do not describe an unmerged PR as deployed. See [release maintenance](https://github.com/tobygodat/typingsite/blob/master/docs/releases.md).
